# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: maps (spec 6.2/6.4). Keys are text, always; a map iterates
# only by fold.

== length counts pairs
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Length()
want Num 2

== keys come sorted
env limits: Map(Num) = {"lo": 2, "hi": 10}
expr limits.Keys().Join(",")
want Text "hi,lo"

== values ride beside their keys
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Values().Sum()
want Num 12

== has
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Has("hi")
want Bool true

== has misses
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Has("mid")
want Bool false

== get
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Get("hi")
want Num 10

== get of a missing key is unknown
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Get("mid")
want nil

== indexing a map by key
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits["lo"]
want Num 2

== indexing by a missing key is unknown
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits["mid"]
want nil

== map keys builtin
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr Keys(limits).Length()
want Num 2

== map values builtin
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr Values(limits).Max()
want Num 10

== a map folds
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Reduce((acc, key, value) => acc + value, 0)
want Num 12

== a map fold reads its keys
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Reduce((acc, key, value) => acc + key, "")
want Text "hilo"

== a map does not map
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Map(v => v)
error iterate a map with reduce

== a map does not filter
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10, "lo": 2}
expr limits.Filter(v => v > 1)
error iterate a map with reduce

== a map fold names all three
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10}
expr limits.Reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0)
error 3 lambda parameters

== indexing a map wants Text
env limits: Map(Num) = {"hi": 10}
expr limits[0]
error map key wants Text
